title: allowissadula lozanoi
intro: Allowissadula lozanoi, commonly known as the Mexican desert marigold, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Allowissadula lozanoi include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
